welcome.title: The Way of Redemption
welcome.paragraph1: Welcome to our premier Muay Thai gym on the stunning Sunshine Coast. At Redemption, we pride ourselves on providing top-notch training in the art of Muay Thai in a family-oriented environment with no room for egos.
welcome.paragraph2: Since 2020, we have been dedicated to helping individuals of all ages and skill levels achieve their fitness goals while fostering a sense of community and support.
welcome.bento1Desc: Train hard, stay humble. Everyone is family here.
welcome.bento2Desc: From seasoned fighters to day-one beginners.

coach.name: Billy Coulter
coach.subtitle: Veteran & Champion
coach.bio: Billy Coulter is a seasoned Muay Thai veteran and the esteemed head coach of Redemption Muay Thai, a gym he proudly runs with his wife, Teagan. With 12 years of experience in the sport, Billy's journey began at age 20.
achievements: Fought in Destiny, Eruption & Muay Thai League

coachesList.name: Billy Coulter
coachesList.subtitle: Head Coach & Founder
coachesList.bio: Billy Coulter is a seasoned Muay Thai veteran and the esteemed head coach of Redemption Muay Thai. With 12 years of striking experience, Billy has dedicated his career to building champions and fostering a supportive gym environment.
achievements: Fought in Destiny, Eruption & Muay Thai League

coachesList.name: Teagan Coulter
coachesList.subtitle: Co-Owner & Assistant Coach
coachesList.bio: Teagan co-runs Redemption Muay Thai alongside Billy, bringing energy, technical precision, and passion to our junior and adult conditioning programs.
